metadata.title: एक आदिवासी भाषा के लिए बढ़ता आंदोलन | Tribal women fight for roman  script of Kokborok language
metadata.description: Kokborok is the language of tribal population of Tripura. This language is part of the curriculum in school and colleges. As of now this language is written in Bangla script. But most of the tribal people want this language to be written in roman script. The main opposition party Tipra Motha is building up a strong movement for this demand in Tripura. watch this ground report from Tripura.
